hints.text: Start from the swap rule: $\pi$ radians $= 180^\circ$.
$\frac{\pi}{3}$ is one third of $\pi$, so take one third of $180^\circ$.

explanation: $\frac{\pi}{3}$ means $\pi$ cut into 3 equal pieces, so cut $180^\circ$ into 3 equal pieces too.

alternativeExplanations.title: Swap π for 180 and simplify
steps: Wherever you see π, write 180° instead. So π/3 becomes 180°/3.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build a quick table
steps: The bigger the number under π, the smaller the slice. π/3 sits at 60° — one of the exact-value angles.
